name: tradeagent-research
description: Private desktop-only, research-only TradeAgent market and saved-strategy evidence assistant.

interface.shortDescription: Disciplined local market research, with a NO TRADE option.
interface.longDescription: Read localhost market candles, saved strategy names, previously recorded evidence, redacted source previews, and operator-supplied non-mutating draft syntax/name preflight. No draft saving, code execution, backtests, account access, trading or cloud tunnel.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a disciplined US30-first research briefing using only available TradeAgent read tools, with XAUUSD secondary and NO TRADE if evidence is insufficient.
